spec.name: sprint36_taker_imbalance_fade_short_majors
spec.hypothesis: sprint22/23 scored 'fade_extreme' specs LONG due to a confirmed engine defect (params.direction/side unread). This re-scores sprint22's majors cell SHORT after extreme buy-imbalance.
spec.power_argument: sprint22 already realized n=475 validation trades on this exact universe/window/threshold (>300 floor). Sign-flipping its realized stats implies short mean_net ~+11.1bps at t~+9.3, above PASS bar and T1 cost floor -- a confirmatory re-score, not a blind search.
spec.prerequisite: HELD -- do not run until run_split is patched to invert PnL when params.side=='short'; unmodified it silently reproduces sprint22's long result under a new name.
